 Beyond the PDRN Name: PYDERIN Shares the Story Behind Its Ingredients
 November 4, 2026 Evertise 
 The Korean PDRN specialist makes its North American debut through Amazon US with a Lift Cream backed by disclosed purity and molecular-weight verification. 
 PDRN is attracting attention across the K-beauty market, but products featuring the same ingredient can differ in the origin and quality of their raw materials, as well as how they are developed. PYDERIN, a South Korean skincare brand specializing in PDRN, has made those distinctions central to its approach. 
 The brand’s origins lie in the questions raised by professionals who have spent years studying and treating skin. Dermatologist Dr. Kim Jung-bin, who has more than 20 years of clinical experience, participated in product development alongside Dr. Sung Ki-soo and pharmacist Kim Jung-hyun. According to the brand, their aim was to bring professional knowledge of skin into skincare products designed for everyday use. 
 That development background also shaped PYDERIN’s criteria for selecting PDRN. Rather than focusing solely on the ingredient’s name or concentration, the brand has sought to share specific raw-material specifications, including origin, purity and molecular weight. 
 PYDERIN PDRN Lift Cream uses PDRN derived from Korean chum salmon. The brand reports a raw-ingredient purity of at least 99% and a molecular weight of 97 kDa, supported by materials including a certificate of origin and purity verification documentation. The 99% figure refers to the purity of the PDRN raw ingredient, not its concentration in the finished cream. 
 The cream also contains seven types of collagen and acetyl hexapeptide-8. PYDERIN describes the formulation as designed with skin hydration and a smooth, firm-looking appearance in mind, combining attention to raw-material quality with the experience of everyday use. 
 This focus on ingredients has also extended to open discussion with specialists. In July 2026, PYDERIN held its REDEFINE SYMPOSIUM at Josun Palace in Seoul. Presentations covered PDRN raw-material characteristics, molecular weight, quality control and research findings on skin application. Dermatology and pharmacy professionals took part in discussions about the potential of PDRN skincare and the evidence behind it. 
 While building its professional identity around ingredients and research, PYDERIN has also broadened its connections with consumers in South Korea. 
 Outdoor advertising in Myeongdong and Hongdae, two of Seoul’s prominent shopping and tourism districts, formed part of that effort. The brand appointed actor Kim Ji-hoon as its model and introduced PYDERIN through digital advertising displays in major commercial areas of the city. The campaign sought to reach both Korean consumers and international visitors. 
 PYDERIN has also begun appearing in global beauty media. In September 2026, a K-beauty trends article in U.S. Vogue featured PYDERIN as a Korean skincare brand specializing in high-purity PDRN. 
 The direction the brand developed with specialists in South Korea now extends to the U.S. market. With PDRN Lift Cream available through Amazon US, PYDERIN has established a way to reach North American consumers. 
 Its emphasis remains the same: going beyond a trending K-beauty ingredient to explain who contributed to product development, which raw materials were selected and the standards behind the formulation. 
 For PYDERIN, the story extends beyond the PDRN name to encompass its ingredients, development background and brand activities in South Korea. Together, these elements introduce U.S. consumers to another option in PDRN skincare. 
 Further information about the brand and its products is available on PYDERIN’s official website and official YouTube channel . PDRN Lift Cream is now available through   Amazon US .
